question.problem:
Find the formula for the $n$th term of the arithmetic sequence that has ${a}_{25}=95$ and the common difference $d=4.$

${a}_{n}=$
{{field-1}}$,\,n\ge 1$
question.worked_solution:
Since ${a}_{25}=95$ is $24$ jumps after ${a}_{1},$ we can determine the first term of the sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{25} & ={a}_{1}+24d \\ 95 & ={a}_{1}+24(4) \\ 95 & ={a}_{1}+96 \\ -1 & ={a}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the formula for the $n$th term is:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)d \\  & =-1+(n-1)(4) \\  & =-1+4n-4 \\  & =4n-5\end{aligned}
$$
